about.intro_content: Prof. Feng Wang is Professor, Assistant President and Director of the Department of Medical Oncology at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou. She has extensive expertise in gastrointestinal medical oncology and sees thousands of GI cancer patients annually.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Wang completed her PhD at UT MD Anderson Cancer Center. She has published more than 105 peer-reviewed articles, including in Nature Medicine, Cancer Cell, Journal of Clinical Oncology, JAMA Oncology, Annals of Oncology, The Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology, and Gut. She led the JUPITER-06 phase 3 trial establishing toripalimab plus chemotherapy for treatment-naïve advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, and a randomized phase 2 trial of perioperative toripalimab and chemotherapy for locally advanced gastric or gastro-esophageal junction cancer, both published in Nature Medicine/Cancer Cell. She is a member of the ESMO Pan-Asian Gastric Cancer Guidelines expert group and Secretary-General of the CSCO Colorectal Cancer Guidelines expert group.

items.question: Does Prof. Feng Wang accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to gastrointestinal cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Wang's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Wang specialises in gastrointestinal medical oncology, including gastric, esophageal and colorectal cancer, with a focus on clinical trials and translational research.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Has Prof. Wang led any landmark cancer trials?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Wang led the JUPITER-06 phase 3 trial establishing toripalimab plus chemotherapy for advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, and a Nature Medicine-published trial on perioperative immunotherapy for gastric cancer.

items.question: Is Prof. Wang involved in setting national treatment guidelines?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Wang serves as Secretary-General of the CSCO Colorectal Cancer Guidelines expert group and is a member of the ESMO Pan-Asian Gastric Cancer Guidelines expert group.
